bullets.text: Windows 11 2025 Update Released - **Microsoft** announces the availability of the Windows 11, version 25H2 update for eligible devices.
TypeScript 7 Native Preview - **Visual Studio 2026** introduces TypeScript 7 native preview, significantly improving compile times and performance.
AI-Powered Security with Sentinel - **Microsoft Sentinel** enhances security capabilities to protect organizations in the age of AI.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Builds - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders, featuring network speed tests and improved search.
AI Auto-Categorization in Photos - **Microsoft Photos** now features AI-powered auto-categorization for easier photo management.
Microsoft Marketplace Launch - **Microsoft** introduces a unified Marketplace for cloud solutions and AI apps, enhancing customer access.
Expanding AI Agents in Microsoft 365 - **Microsoft 365 Copilot** now includes additional AI models for enhanced productivity.
AI vs. AI in Cybersecurity - **Microsoft** detects an AI-obfuscated phishing campaign, showcasing the evolving threat landscape.
